residual_risks: Review validation ran 37 focused behavioral tests, all passing; no production mutation testing was performed. The native module test uses a portable classic-loader harness, with actual DSH ClientModuleSystem execution documented separately rather than exercised in that test.
testing_gaps: lib/audio-review.js executeReviewJob promises that each 15-item batch commits before the next and cancellation or model failure retains prior decisions. Existing audio-review and subtitle-review-flow tests cover pure application and a one-item successful review only. Add a public audio.corrections.review test with more than 15 uncertain items, gate the second model batch, cancel or fail it, then assert the first batch persists consistently in sources and audioResults while the remaining suggestions are still pending.
